checks.title: Dimension bound (Wh/L)
checks.summary: Not assessed. The listed dimensions describe the package, not the product.
notes: The listed dimensions (150 × 150 × 150 mm) are package dimensions. Package figures often describe the shipping box or are placeholders, so they are not used as a bound.
All three dimensions are equal, a common placeholder pattern.
The listed volume is 192.3× the 18650 envelope, so it does not describe the cell.
checks.not_assessed_reason: The listed dimensions describe the package, not the product.
